thread:
lara_sales: Quick POC question from Cicci: they have SD-WAN -> TGW (active/active across two regions). want PrivateLink into our connector in primary region with an automated fallback to an egress proxy in the secondary region. Must preserve client source IP and use mutual TLS. Also need minimal firewall port list and a 1TB/month cost delta vs Hosted. Any immediate blockers?

mike_se: Short answer: doable. PrivateLink is regional so you need an interface endpoint in each region. Front it with a TCP NLB configured to preserve source IP (default). Avoid NAT in the path to keep client IP. For mTLS, terminate at the connector or validate client certs at the app layer.

jo_netops: A couple clarifying Qs: 1) Do you control SD-WAN local-pref via BGP? 2) Is TLS inspected anywhere in their network? 3) Do they want cross-region stateful sessions preserved?

cicci_customer: We do BGP with local-pref control. No TLS inspect, we want TLS end-to-end. We can tolerate session restart on failover.

mike_se: With BGP local-pref you can flip preferred region on fail by lowering local-pref for the primary - simplest. Alternative: an automation that updates a TGW route table/prefix-list target. Session restart is expected on region flip.

jo_netops: Minimal firewall checklist for their edge/TGW & proxy: 
- Spoke/TGW -> endpoint ENI: TCP 443 (API)
- Allow NLB health checks -> connector health port (TCP 8080 or configured port)
- If proxy used for failover: Spoke -> proxy ENI: TCP 443; proxy -> primary NLB: TCP 443 for probes
- Management/telemetry (optional): outbound to telemetry FQDNs on TCP 443
We'll provide exact ENI CIDRs after endpoint creation.

mike_se: MTU/overlay gotcha: SD-WAN overlays can shrink PMTU. Recommend MSS clamp at their edge. Example iptables rule (illustrative):
```
iptables -t mangle -A FORWARD -p tcp --tcp-flags SYN,RST SYN -j TCPMSS --clamp-mss-to-pmtu
```
This avoids TLS handshake fragmentation.

cicci_customer: Good. What's the cost difference vs Hosted for roughly 1TB/month?

mike_se: Quick sketch: PrivateLink endpoint ~ small hourly ENI charge + per-GB processing (AWS regional price), NLB hourly + per-GB LB data processing, plus any egress across regions. Hosted: no infra, pay per-token/usage (higher variable). Dedicated: would lower per-token inference cost for steady traffic but adds fixed monthly commit and ops. We'll put numbers in the ticket.

lara_sales: Action items: jo to write BGP runbook for local-pref failover + MSS note; mike to produce endpoint+NLB+cross-region egress 1TB sketch; I'll send a simple diagram and circle back. Please drop deliverables in the ticket by EOD tomorrow. :thumbsup:

bot-deploy: Created ticket POC-44221: "atomic-failover-play-privatelink-egress" assigned to jo_netops,mike_se - https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/POC-44221

cicci_customer: thanks — please include exact SG/IP ranges and a short smoke test we can run during the POC.

jo_netops: Will do, smoke test will be: curl --resolve <endpoint-host>:443:<endpoint-ip> --insecure https://<endpoint-host>/health ; verify client IP logged and mTLS handshake succeeds.

lara_sales: perfect, thanks team.
